name: Bogey One
description: Bogey One was the codename of a Grysk Warship given to it by the crew of the Springhawk. Bogey One participated in a battle against the Springhawk and the Aelos. Bogey One looked like a smaller version of a Shatter-class WarMaster. Bogey One employed the tactic of dibbers to protects its missiles. It escaped the battle after destroying the Kilji picket cruiser Hammer.
